prompt.pieceMoves: Click every square the {piece} on {square} can move to.
prompt.positionStatus: Black to move. What is this position?
prompt.escapeCheck: The white king on {square} is in check. Which squares can it escape to?
prompt.sanPiece: In the move {san}, which piece moves?
prompt.freeCapture: One enemy piece is undefended. Take it without being recaptured!
prompt.materialCount: Count material (pawn 1, knight 3, bishop 3, rook 5, queen 9). Who is ahead?
prompt.bestCapture: You can take several pieces for free. Choose the best capture!

explain.pieceMoves: Green squares are correct; green outlines are squares you missed, red ones were wrong.
explain.positionStatus: Check: the king is attacked. Checkmate: in check with no escape. Stalemate: not in check but no legal move.
explain.escapeCheck: The king may not move onto an attacked square — including squares on the checking line.
explain.readMove: The first letter is the piece (K king, Q queen, R rook, B bishop, N knight; no letter means a pawn), the end is the target square.
explain.sanPiece: K = king, Q = queen, R = rook, B = bishop, N = knight; no letter = pawn.
explain.freeCapture: A "hanging" piece is attacked and undefended. Always look for them!
explain.mateIn1: Checkmate: the enemy king is in check and cannot escape.
explain.materialCount: Add up each side's points and subtract.
explain.bestCapture: With several captures available, take the most valuable piece that cannot be recaptured.

guide.title: Guide
guide.heroSubtitle: Everything you need to know: why chess is great, what is here, and how points and ranks work.

why.title: Why play chess?
why.intro: Chess is about 1,500 years old — it grew out of chaturanga in India — and today hundreds of millions of people play it.

think.title: 🧠 Sharpens thinking
think.body: Every move is a small puzzle: calculate, compare options, predict your opponent.

focus.title: 🎯 Focus & patience
focus.body: A game teaches you to sit still, look closely and not rush.

learn.title: 📈 Learn from losses
learn.body: Every loss comes with a clear lesson — review it, see the mistake, do better next time.

fun.title: 🌏 For every age
fun.body: Simple rules, playable with anyone, anywhere — and you never run out of things to learn.

free.title: 🆓 Free, no ads
free.body: No account needed: type a name and play.

path.title: 🪜 Step-by-step learning
path.body: Lessons with interactive boards, quizzes and puzzles — from the rules to tactics.

bots.title: 🐣 Opponents with character
bots.body: Each bot has its own strength, style and personality — from Chick to Master.

review.title: 🔍 Understand wins and losses
review.body: Stockfish reviews every move, points out mistakes and lets you retry them.

offline.title: 📴 Plays offline
offline.body: Install it like an app; your data stays on your device.

fun.title: 🎨 Your style
fun.body: 9 themes, piece sets, generated music, vi / en / ja.

learn.title: 📖 Learn
learn.body: {lessons} lessons in chapters: the board, every piece, special rules, basic tactics.

practice.title: 🧩 Practice
practice.body: {quiz} hand-written quiz questions + endless generated ones; thousands of rated and themed puzzles, Puzzle Rush and a daily puzzle.

play.title: ♟️ Play
play.body: {bots} bots + a Custom bot (Elo 250–3000), 5 playing styles, clocks; or two players on one device.

review.title: 🔍 Game review
review.body: Every move classified, accuracy, an evaluation chart, retry your mistakes.

steps.0: Go through the “Basics” chapter to learn how each piece moves.
steps.1: Do a few “Pieces” and “Rules” quiz rounds.
steps.2: Play the 🐣 Chick — don’t be afraid to lose!
steps.3: Open “Review” to see where it went wrong and retry the mistakes.
steps.4: Solve the daily puzzle every day to keep your 🔥 streak and improve steadily.

points.title: Three kinds of points
points.intro: Each measures something different; they never affect each other.

rank.title: 🏆 Rank points (bot games)
rank.body: You start at {start}. Win to go up, lose to go down — beating stronger bots earns more (Glicko-2). Only games without hints or take-backs count.

puzzle.title: 🧩 Puzzle rating
puzzle.body: Starts at {start}. Solving right away without hints wins the puzzle; anything else counts as a loss. The next puzzles match your level.

xp.title: ✨ XP & levels
xp.body: Everything earns XP: lessons, quizzes, puzzles, games, reviews. XP is never taken away.

ranks.title: The rank ladder
ranks.intro: Your rank is your title against the bots. Each rank is guarded by a “boss”.

rules.0: Each rank has 3 tiers III → II → I of {tier} points each.
rules.1: Reach the points of the next rank → a promotion match opens: beat that rank’s boss to move up.
rules.2: Losing a promotion match only keeps you at tier I — retry as often as you like.
rules.3: Once earned, a rank is never lost (you can drop tiers inside it).
rules.4: No penalty for breaks. Games with hints or take-backs are practice games and are not rated.

xp.title: XP, streaks & achievements

rows.lesson: Finish a lesson for the first time

xp.level: Levels: each level needs more XP than the last ({step} × current level).
xp.streak: Streak 🔥: do something every day to keep it; miss a day and it starts again.
xp.achievements: {count} achievements to unlock — see your profile.

items.0: Take the center with your e/d pawns.
items.1: Develop knights and bishops before the queen.
items.2: Castle early to keep your king safe.
items.3: Before every move ask: “What is my opponent threatening?”
items.4: Count material: don’t trade a strong piece for a weak one.
items.5: Review every loss — the fastest way to improve.

data.title: Where is my data stored?
data.body: In this browser (IndexedDB). No server, no account. Use Profile → Export data to back it up or move to another device.

lose.title: Can I lose my data?
lose.body: Yes, if you clear the browser’s data. Export a save file now and then to be safe.

mobile.title: Can I play on my phone?
mobile.body: Yes. You can even “Add to Home Screen” and use it like an app, offline too.

unrated.title: Why wasn’t my game rated?
unrated.body: Because a hint or a take-back was used. The app always asks first.

bots.title: How strong are the bots?
bots.body: From about 250 Elo (Chick, very random) to full Stockfish strength (Master). The Custom bot lets you pick anything in between.
